rootCause: R14 intentionally removed projection batchRunner/clientBatch so the server-confirmed product store remained the authoritative base. The runtime diagnostics footer still referenced !!clientBatch, producing a ReferenceError after the list rendered.
fix: Keep server-confirmed store authority; do not restore clientBatch. Replace the stale diagnostic with batchRead:false and baseAuthority:'server-confirmed-store'; advance the Client 360 cache binding and assert no clientBatch identifier remains.
